evidence.detail: Exact v308 rs/s/c/f extends Overlay and reproduces the RuneLite SceneOverlay color palette and geometry constants: map-square green, chunk-border blue, movement colors (141,220,26)/(73,122,18), line-of-sight (204,42,219), interacting cyan, local tile size 128, chunk size 8, map-square size 64, border cull 16, stroke width 4 and interacting shift -16.

The class renders scene/map-square grid geometry from LocalPoint/WorldPoint coordinates, labels map squares, and draws local scene diagnostics under the Developer Tools configuration, matching the SceneOverlay role rather than a generic plugin overlay.

RuneLite SceneOverlay at 68c819924cfd6bfb4848c71f74c121109f289d5a has the same overlay superclass, distinctive six-color palette, 128/8/64/16/4/-16 geometry constants and scene-grid diagnostics. SpawnPK extends the interaction/mouse tooling but preserves the source identity.

candidates.note: SceneOverlay is anchored by the distinctive RuneLite constant set and scene-geometry behavior, not package proximity. Confidence 0.999.
